appraisal_events.evidence: on vint nous faire lever sur l'ordre de M. de Stermaria... sans le moindre geste d'excuse à notre adresse, pria à haute voix le maître d'hôtel de veiller à ce qu'une pareille erreur ne se renouvelât pas, car il lui était désagréable que « des gens qu'il ne connaissait pas » eussent pris sa table.
appraisal_events.explanation: M. de Stermaria has the narrator's party summarily ejected from his table without apology, publicly and loudly framing them as unwelcome strangers who had no business there.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's family is abruptly displaced from their table and publicly marked, without apology, as intruding strangers.
The narrator's description of Stermaria as glacial, rushed, distant, rude, fussy, and ill-intentioned locally diminishes him even as he asserts his prerogative over the table.

ambiguities: The displaced party is referred to collectively as 'nous' (the narrator's traveling party); no individual family member besides the narrator is separately named, so 'le narrateur' stands in for the group as the target of the snub.
